description: Automotive Maintenance teaches how a car or truck works and how to care for it — safety, dashboards, tires, engine, cooling, fuel, ignition and electrical systems, drive train and brakes, including electric and hybrid vehicles.

safety.note: Work on vehicles only with a knowledgeable adult, on a level surface with the engine off and cool, and never under a vehicle supported only by a jack.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Numbers follow the order in which the official page lists the topic areas; sub-items, which include electric and hybrid vehicles, are summarized. You need access to a vehicle and its owner’s manual.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
